About optional text messages

Sign in to your account, enter a phone number you own, and select the optional text-message categories for your lawn-care provider. Each category requires a separate choice. You can receive arrival and completion updates (up to 2 status texts per visit), optional additional-service offers (up to 3 offer texts per day), and approaching, rescheduling or cancellation notices where available (message frequency varies).

Message and data rates may apply. Consent is not required to purchase service. Reply STOP to opt out or HELP for help. Text replies do not approve work or authorize charges. For support, email support@mowmatter.com. Read our Terms and Privacy Policy.
